title: knowledge(testing): ExpectedError must identify the intended error
summary: The testing knowledge article on assertion errors now clarifies that ExpectedError and ExpectedErrorCode match by substring, and adds guidance to avoid weak verification patterns that cannot distinguish between different errors.
key_points: Both ExpectedError and ExpectedErrorCode match by substring
Best practice asks for text only the intended error produces, ideally the full Label with arguments built with StrSubstNo
ExpectedErrorCode on its own identifies only the kind of error
New anti-patterns: ExpectedErrorCode alone, a non-empty GetLastErrorText() check, or a fragment shared by several messages on the same code path
With these weak checks a test stays green when an earlier validation fires instead of the one under test
